frontmatter.title: CISSP, Offensive Security Director @Abissi
frontmatter.subtitle: Secure-by-Design Cybersecurity, Informed by Real-World Attacks
frontmatter.content: Security risk is built into products long before the first vulnerability is found. I work with organizations to identify and eliminate that risk at the source — embedding security into engineering strategy, product design, and governance before it becomes a liability. 15+ years across software engineering and offensive security. Active contributor to European cybersecurity standardization, including horizontal standards for Cyber Resilience Act compliance
